name: Find the Gap
body:
You are adept at spotting the weak spots in your target’s defenses.

Prerequisite(s): sneak attack +1d6

Benefit(s): When you are attacking a creature while they are flanked or would otherwise lose their Dexterity bonus to their AC, you have an added benefit on the attack. Reduce the target’s armor, shield, or natural armor bonuses by 1/2 the number of your sneak attack dice, to a minimum of 0.
